sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B-GPTQ · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We are releasing MiniCPM5-2B, the second model in the MiniCPM5series, following MiniCPM5-1B. It is a dense 2B Transformer that scales up the same training recipe, built for on-device, local deployment, and resource-constrained scenarios, reaching 2B-class open-source SOTA.

sources.title: MiniCPM5-2B Review: Benchmarks & Performance
sources.snippet: Yes. MiniCPM5-2B is a serious small language model for local AI, coding assistance, reasoning, tool use and lightweight agent workflows. Its biggest strengths are capability per parameter, a native 131K context window, multiple local deployment formats and strong results on OpenBMB’s code, math and tool-use evaluations.
